I will put one bag of fertilizer from the agro-dealer and some cow manure on this plot because that is what I did last season and the harvest was enough to see us through. I am using my own saved sorghum seed since it costs nothing and I know it will grow here, and I will not spend on chemicals when the rains decide everything anyway. My family will do most of the work on this plot over the season, but I will hire a few young men to help when the weeds come up thick.
